in_sanskrit.name: गुह्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: that which is concealed or hidden

in_marathi.name: Guhya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Guhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Guhya is the name of a god associated with secrets and hidden things. The god is often depicted as having the power to make things unseen or unknown visible again.
